subsegment: Onshore wind farm — utility-scale (60-100 turbines, 150-400 MW)
description: Utility-scale onshore wind generation projects on agricultural or rangeland sites, typically structured as fixed-price EPC with separate turbine supply agreements (TSA) wrapped under the EPC. Schedule is dominated by tax-credit safe-harbor windows and seasonal access constraints.

typical_risks.description_template: Single-source nacelle supply from {oem} exposes schedule to factory delivery slippage; nacelle bottleneck would defer COD beyond PTC safe-harbor window.
COD must precede IRA tax-credit step-down on {deadline_date}; any 4+ week slip materially erodes project economics for owner and triggers LDs.
Caisson and spread-footing designs assumed competent bedrock at <8m; site investigation across {n_turbines} pads may reveal variable depth-to-rock requiring redesign.
Specialised LR-series crawler crane crews are regionally scarce during peak wind construction season; mobilisation slip cascades into turbine erection sequence.
Sustained winds above 11 m/s and icing conditions prevent main-component lifts; {region} historical data suggests 6-10 week erection blackout from December to February.
USFWS eagle take permit conditions impose seasonal construction restrictions; non-compliance triggers permit suspension and stop-work.
Network upgrade scope on the {utility} side may shift through SIS/Facilities Study revisions, exposing schedule to transmission owner delivery dates outside EPC control.
Crossing agreements with {n_landowners} parcel owners along collection lines may produce localised access denials forcing route revisions.

typical_issues.description_template: State DOT oversize-load permit for blade delivery delayed, holding turbine erection sequence.
Domestic rebar lead time extended; foundation pour sequence at risk for next 4 weeks.
Met tower SCADA outage during commissioning created a wind data gap requiring extended performance test window.
Two MV collection cable splice failures detected during energisation; remediation across affected runs in progress.
GSU transformer ex-works date slipped by {n_weeks} weeks; substation backfeed sequence rebaselined.
Heavy rain caused crane pad subgrade failure at pads {pad_ids}; remediation and re-survey required before next lift.
Recordable injury during nacelle internal work; stand-down completed, root cause under investigation.
Turbine-level punch list closure lagging COD requirement; warranty handover at risk.
FAA-compliant obstruction lighting controller firmware issue delaying final acceptance.
Initial PPA capacity test underperformed by {pct}%; investigation into curtailment and curve underperformance underway.

typical_co_drivers: Interconnection network upgrade scope additions from utility re-study
Differing site conditions at foundation locations requiring redesign
Collection line re-routing around late-identified wetland or cultural resource
Acceleration directive to preserve tax-credit COD window
